/bin/zsh -lc 'set -u
OUT="docs/acceptance/task-c44b33d9-g33-fresh"

WEBPORT=17100
GRPCPORT=17101
SOCK="$TMPDIR_AC/admin.sock"
MASTER="$TMPDIR_AC/master.key"
CONFIG="$TMPDIR_AC/config.yaml"
openssl rand -base64 32 > "$MASTER"
chmod 600 "$MASTER"
printf '"'server:\\n  listen_addr: \":%s\"\\n  sqlite_path: \"%s\"\\n  admin_socket_path: \"%s\"\\nweb_console:\\n  enabled: true\\n  listen_addr: \"127.0.0.1:%s\"\\nsecret_management:\\n  master_key_file: \"%s\"\\n' \""'$GRPCPORT" "$TMPDIR_AC/agent-center.db" "$SOCK" "$WEBPORT" "$MASTER" > "$CONFIG"

PID=$!
cleanup() { kill "$PID" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; wait "$PID" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; agent-browser close >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; }
trap cleanup EXIT
ready=0
for i in $(seq 1 80); do
  if curl -fsS "http://127.0.0.1:$WEBPORT/api/health" > "$OUT/raw/11-api-health.raw.json" 2> "$OUT/raw/11-api-health.curl.log"; then ready=1; break; fi
  sleep 0.1
done

  echo "server_not_ready" | tee "$OUT/raw/10-server-ready-failed.log"
  exit 1
fi
curl -sS -D "$OUT/raw/12-api-health.headers" "http://127.0.0.1:$WEBPORT/api/health" -o "$OUT/raw/12-api-health.body.json"

agent-browser screenshot "$OUT/ui/version-page.png" > "$OUT/raw/17-ui-screenshot.log" 2>&1
'
